Name: service
Description: App service (e.g. http ftp smtp dns ssh)

Name: state
Description: State and its dependent protocol (e.g. FIN INT CON)

Name: sttl
Description: Source to destination time to live value

Name: dttl
Description: Destination to source time to live value

Name: smean
Description: Mean packet size transmitted by source

Name: dmean
Description: Mean packet size transmitted by destination

Name: response_body_len
Description: Actual uncompressed content length transferred from server

Name: ct_srv_src
Description: No. of connections that contain same service and source address in 100 connections

Name: ct_state_ttl
Description: No. of connections for specific state according to TTL values

Name: ct_dst_ltm
Description: No. of connections of same destination address in 100 connections

Name: ct_src_dport_ltm
Description: No. of connections of same source address and destination port in 100 connections

Name: ct_dst_sport_ltm
Description: No. of connections of same destination address and source port in 100 connections

Name: ct_dst_src_ltm
Description: No. of connections of same source and destination address in 100 connections

Name: is_ftp_login
Description: 1 if FTP session logged in with password

Name: ct_ftp_cmd
Description: No of flow commands in FTP session

Name: ct_flw_http_mthd
Description: No. of flows that has HTTP methods like GET and POST

Name: ct_src_ltm
Description: No. of connections of same source address in 100 connections

Name: ct_srv_dst
Description: No. of connections of same service and destination address in 100 connections

Name: is_sm_ips_ports
Description: 1 if source and destination IP/ports are equal

Name: attack_cat
Description: Name of cyber threat category (Exploits DoS Generic etc.)

Name: label
Description: 0 for normal traffic 1 for attack traffic
